gen-press-start-2p-fs-asap: Press Start 2P spaces its blocky letters out like cut-outs pinned far apart. Asap, a sans-serif, answers with a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and c forms like open arcs, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-epilogue: Epilogue's curvy, wire-thin sans-serif letters feel unclamped, with tall bodies and stubby ascender tips, set against Press Start 2P's softly inked heading. Paragraphs flow lightly.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-merriweather-sans: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P carries a faint pencil-line taper in its strokes, while Merriweather Sans stands sturdy with tall lowercase and a clearly open e. One shouts for attention; the other quietly holds the words.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad counters to the table, a sturdy sans-serif beside Press Start 2P's faintly shifting strokes. Its strongest quality is that sturdy, trustworthy weight.
gen-gf-gugi-general-sans: Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to the capitals, with cut-open terminals. General Sans, a sans-serif, follows with a steady pen pressure, a generous x-height and smooth bends, which makes the pairing feel confident and unfussy.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and open, its wide e never squeezed shut and every stroke cut to one width. Beside it, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its terminals pointing outward, so the two feel loose and friendly together.
gen-gf-metamorphous-switzer: Switzer, a plain sans, runs tubular and wire-like with a tall waist line. Metamorphous adds soft ink-like fat and slim strokes above it, so the strongest quality is the pair's gentle contrast between hand and ruler.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-manrope: Manrope opens a bright gap at every curve and barely steps down from cap to lowercase, holding one pen width throughout. Early GameBoy stretches wide above it with a pen-like swell in its bowls, so the two look playful yet tidy.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-supreme: Supreme reads as a thick, crisp strip of text, its sans letters held open rather than curled shut. Quantum, loose and single-weight, sits lightly above it, and the page feels brisk.
gen-righteous-archivo: Archivo's curves open outward and its x-height stands tall. Righteous, bent like thin steel rod with bowls that fill the line, makes the pair feel bold, fun and editorial all at once.
